answer_1.quote: Understanding structured knowledge, e.g., information encoded in tables, and automatically generating natural-language descriptions is an important task in the area of Natural Language Generation.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we apply the widely used evaluation metrics including the standard BLEU-4, METEOR and ROUGE scores to evaluate the generation quality... we also apply the PARENT metric... we further modify the PARENT metric to measure the level of matching between generated texts and the corresponding tables. We denote this new metric as PARENT-T.

answer_4.quote: Following , we conduct extensive human evaluation on the generated descriptions... for each group of generated texts, we ask the human raters to evaluate the grammar, fluency, and faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: The raters are trained with word instructions and text examples of the grading standard beforehand, evaluating grammar, fluency, and faithfulness based on predefined criteria.
